construct_or_mutation: His6-tagged E. coli DamX SPOR domain, residues 338-428 (SPOR domain proper 344-428), wild type
other_conditions: 0.7 mM protein, 90% H2O/10% D2O; tumbling: tau_m = 6.98 ns; related structures: 2LFV (this study's ensemble, deposited with BMRB 17783), 1X60 (CwlC SPOR), 1UTA (FtsN SPOR); model assignments shown only as colours in Figure 3C; per-residue S2/NOE values are plotted, not tabulated
caveat_note: Rex magnitudes, S2 values and internal correlation times are not given in the text. Only the models and residue list are stated. The Rex of T405 is attributed by the authors to the nearby proline kink (P407).
experiment: 15N T1, 15N T2 and {1H}-15N NOE at 600 MHz, model-free analysis (Fast-Modelfree / ModelFree 4.20)
author_claim: alpha1/beta2 loop, beta2/beta3 loop and alpha3 through the C-terminus show reduced S2 and NOE; T405, R421, V423, Q424 fit model 4 (S2 + fast internal motion + Rex) and K428 fits model 5; no residue fits model 3; alpha3 described as relatively mobile.
anchor: The chemical exchange of R421, V423, and Q424, as well as the more complex motions of K428 at the C-terminus, are consistent with enhanced overall motion of α3.
locator: Results, Backbone dynamics; Figure 3; conditions: Experimental Procedures, NMR Spectroscopy and Protein purification

construct_or_mutation: His6-tagged DamX SPOR domain Q351K mutant
other_conditions: HSQC conditions for the mutants are not given separately; temperature, pH and buffer copied from the general NMR methods ('Typically ... 0.7 mM protein in NMR buffer'); regime (authors): not stated; spectra in Supplemental Figure S4C
caveat_note: Mutant, not the deposited wild-type sample. The extra peaks may reflect partial misfolding or a minor conformer; no exchange rate, population or residue list is given and the supplement figure is not available. Mutant spectra conditions are assumed from the general methods.
experiment: 1H-15N HSQC of purified Q351K mutant, compared with wild type (qualitative)
author_claim: Q351K HSQC shows extra peaks, suggesting interconversion between two or more conformations; other localization-defective mutants resemble wild type.
anchor: However, the HSQC spectrum of the Q351K mutant revealed some extra peaks, suggesting this protein interconverts between two or more conformations and is not as close to the native structure as the other mutants
locator: Results, Evaluating expression and folding of the non-localizing SPOR domain mutants; Supplemental Figure S4C (not available); conditions: Experimental Procedures, NMR Spectroscopy
